headline: Zebulon Pike spots his famous peak
post_facts: Pike saw it through a spyglass
His men turned back in deep snow

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in eighteen-oh-six... an explorer spotted the peak that bears his name.

scenes.label: Zebulon Pike
scenes.caption: U.S. Army explorer
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Lieutenant Zebulon Pike saw it like a small blue cloud.

scenes.label: feet high, Pikes Peak, Colorado
scenes.text: [calmly] His men hit waist-deep snow... and turned back.

scenes.label: Pikes Peak today
scenes.caption: Seen from the Garden of the Gods
scenes.text: [softly] Pike wrote that no one could reach the top. Fourteen years later, someone did.

scenes.title: It inspired America the Beautiful
scenes.text: [warmly] In eighteen ninety-three, its summit view inspired America the Beautiful.

scenes.title: Have you been to Pikes Peak?
scenes.text: [gently] Have you been to Pikes Peak?
